info.title: SwiftCloud API
info.description: Deploy apps, manage databases and object storage on SwiftCloud. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — a session token from `cloud login`, or an `sc_` API token bound to one organisation. Long operations return the resource with its `status`; poll until it is terminal.

s3Endpoint.description: Public S3 endpoint for buckets in this region (path-style, signing region us-east-1), or null when none is configured.

name.description: Unique within the organisation. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

status.description: deploying | ready | stopped | suspended | failed | delete_failed | deleting. `ready` is the healthy state. Advanced by the platform worker; poll until terminal (ready, stopped, suspended, failed, delete_failed).

envVars.description: Values are returned; this is configuration, not a secret store.

name.description: Unique within the organisation. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

region.description: Region id or name, e.g. zm-lusaka-central-1

size.description: Pricing tier name (see /pricing). Defaults to the smallest.

envVars.description: Environment variables as a name → value map.

password.description: Registry password or token. Never returned by the API.
